welcome.title: Welcome to møni
welcome.subtitle: A few quick questions so we can set your daily calorie and macro targets — adjusted for training days automatically.

sex.title: What's your sex?
sex.subtitle: Used for the calorie formula (Mifflin-St Jeor).

birthDate.title: When were you born?
birthDate.subtitle: Used to calculate your age for the calorie formula.
birthDate.label: Birth date

body.title: Height & weight
body.subtitle: Values are stored in metric and shown in your preferred unit.

activity.title: Everyday activity
activity.subtitle: How active is your day outside of workouts? Workouts are added separately.
activity.lightDescription: On your feet sometimes, light walking
activity.moderateDescription: Regularly on your feet, some physical work

goal.title: What's your goal?
goal.subtitle: This decides whether we aim for a deficit, maintenance, or a surplus.

rate.title: How fast?
rate.subtitleLose: Target rate of weight loss per week.
rate.subtitleGain: Target rate of weight gain per week.
rate.subtitleMaintain: You're maintaining, so there's no rate to set.

schedule.title: Training days
schedule.subtitle: How many times a week do you train, and on which days?

result.title: Your daily targets
result.subtitle: Your limit adapts automatically: higher on training days, based on what you actually burn.
result.explanation: On rest days your limit is your adjusted maintenance calories. On training days, we add back a share of what you burn (based on your eat-back factor) — mostly as carbs, since protein and fat stay steady.
result.guardrailDeficit: Your requested pace was steeper than a safe deficit (max 25% below maintenance), so we capped it.
result.guardrailSurplus: Your requested pace was steeper than a safe surplus (max +500 kcal/day), so we capped it.
result.guardrailMinimum: Your target hit the safe daily minimum, so we raised it slightly.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to save your targets and start tracking.
signIn.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

otp.title: Sign in with a code
otp.subtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code — no password, no link to tap.

signIn.socialComingSoon: Coming soon — needs an Apple Developer account

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.eatBackFactorDescription: How much of your workout burn gets added back to your limit.
profile.signOutConfirmMessage: You can sign back in any time.
